GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Held Ground untli Two Wide @ 400m. Pushed to quicken Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 200m & held ground in last 150m. # Fair 1st-up run.
Slow Out 1 Lengths Ridden Along Settled Down 9th Inside 7 Lengths held together same to turn clear run home kept trying without threatening was # no prize inside
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly through the middle stages. Laid out rounding the home turn and in the early part of the straight. After passing the 200m raced in restricted room, and continued to lay out under pressure over the final 150m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , got back 2nd last rails 11 Lengths 800m, still mile off then angling to Middle Of Track from the corner, weaved a passage last 200m and powered home into minor placing # ran on strongly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and checked shortly after when tightened for room

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled 3rd last 3 Wide With Cover 7 Lengths 800m, came widest soon after Straightening Up , battled on without getting close, lugging bit first time, tongue control bit off first time, Tongue Tie again # battled widest

Jumped Fair beaten for early speed, settled last 8l off, 4l off b4 turn, pushed along turn easing wide, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, loomed up approaching 100m, kept on strong late, just no match winner final 50m # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out under pressure rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok not busted, drifted back 9 Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong weaving through traffic, took a dive, just missed. # unlucky
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 50m shifted out and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Improved Inside Mid Field 7l. still well back Turn and too far back into Straight . Battled On Well between runners and Made Ground in fight for minors ( ex-R.McCabe. ttie off. t/ctrl 1st time ) # worked home well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 600m commenced to race keenly and was obliged to be steadied. Had its hind quarters turned out after bumping another runner approaching the winning post and was checked as a result.
Slow to begin. Over-raced in the early and middle stages of the event. Near the 1000m became awkwardly placed on the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , in 2-3 Wide middle stages, trailed 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, ran on hitting Lead at the 50m # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.
